description: Single-source implementation checklist tying all 14 documents together. Each task references its source document, lists exact deliverables, and defines the acceptance criteria that confirm the task is complete.
how_to_use: Work through phases in order. Each task must meet its acceptance criteria before moving to the next. Tasks within a phase can be parallelised where noted.

phases.title: Repository & Stack Foundation
phases.description: Establish the project structure, Docker Compose stack, and verify all services start correctly.

tasks.title: Create project repository
acceptance_criteria: git status shows clean working tree
git check-ignore -v .env returns .gitignore:.env

tasks.title: Author docker-compose.yml
acceptance_criteria: docker compose config validates without errors
docker compose ps shows all 9 services listed

tasks.title: Create .env from .env.example
deliverables: .env.example committed with all variables and descriptions
All secrets generated using commands from DOC-12.secret_generation
acceptance_criteria: grep -c CHANGE_ME .env returns 0
chmod 600 .env applied
No .env in git: git ls-files .env returns nothing

tasks.title: Write docker/postgres/init.sql
deliverables: Grants all privileges to homeguard user
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up -d db succeeds
docker compose exec db psql -U homeguard homeguard -c '\dn' shows all 9 schemas

tasks.title: Write Dockerfiles for api, playwright, frontend
acceptance_criteria: docker compose build completes without errors for all services

tasks.title: Write and run init.sh
deliverables: Script is idempotent (safe to run twice)
acceptance_criteria: ./init.sh completes without errors
curl http://localhost:8000/api/system/health returns {status: healthy}
Dashboard loads at http://localhost:3000

tasks.title: Apply host security hardening
deliverables: fail2ban installed and running for SSH and login endpoint
acceptance_criteria: sudo ufw status shows active with correct rules
sudo fail2ban-client status returns homeguard-login jail
gpg --decrypt ~/homeguard-secrets-backup.gpg | grep DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY returns 1 match

phases.title: Database Schema & Migrations
phases.description: Implement all PostgreSQL schemas, tables, and indexes via Alembic migrations.

tasks.title: Implement SQLAlchemy models for identity schema
deliverables: models for profiles, profile_fields, aliases, identity_documents
pgcrypto encryption applied to all PII columns
acceptance_criteria: alembic current shows head
Can INSERT profile with encrypted name and SELECT/decrypt it back
Direct psql SELECT of full_legal_name returns binary (not plain text)

tasks.title: Implement registry, scanning, requests schemas
deliverables: All 12 tables across 3 schemas with FK constraints
acceptance_criteria: All tables exist in DB
FK violations caught on bad inserts
UNIQUE(broker_id, version) enforced on broker_playbooks

tasks.title: Implement mail, audit, reporting, auth schemas
deliverables: audit.audit_log has no update/delete SQLAlchemy methods exposed
acceptance_criteria: All schemas visible in \dn
All tables visible in \dt {schema}.*
Attempting session.delete(audit_log_row) raises AttributeError

tasks.title: Create all recommended indexes
acceptance_criteria: \di in psql shows all indexes
EXPLAIN ANALYZE on scan query uses idx_exposures_active

tasks.title: Implement archive schema and deletion procedure
deliverables: archive schema with mirror tables + archived_at column
acceptance_criteria: Delete test profile → data appears in archive tables → deleted from primary tables → 2 audit log entries created

tasks.title: Seed broker registry
deliverables: Validates each against playbooks/schema.json before insert
Creates at least 20 baseline broker records
acceptance_criteria: python scripts/seed_brokers.py exits 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registry.brokers returns >= 20

phases.title: Core API (Authentication & Profiles)
phases.description: Build FastAPI foundation — auth, profile management, and the API layer shared by all other routers.

tasks.title: FastAPI app skeleton with middleware
deliverables: main.py with lifespan, CORS, rate limiting (slowapi)
Custom error handlers returning error envelope from DOC-5.conventions.error_envelope
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/system/health returns 200
GET /api/profiles with no token returns {error_code: token_missing}
POST /api/auth/login 11 times returns 429 on 11th

tasks.title: Auth router — login, logout, me
deliverables: POST /api/auth/login with bcrypt verify and JWT issue
acceptance_criteria: Critical path CP-01 tests all pass

tasks.title: Profiles router — CRUD and fields
deliverables: Field versioning — effective_to stamped on update
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/profiles creates encrypted profile
Add address → old address gets effective_to stamped → new address is_current=true
Member cannot create or delete profiles (403)

tasks.title: Write auth and profile unit tests
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/unit/api/ -v passes
Coverage >= 80% for api/routers/auth.py and api/routers/profiles.py

phases.title: Broker Registry & n8n Discovery
phases.description: Build broker API endpoints, import n8n workflows, and verify discovery pipeline.

tasks.title: Brokers router — registry, playbooks, webhook
acceptance_criteria: Signed webhook payload upserts brokers
Unsigned payload returns 401 with error_code=webhook_auth_failed
CP-06 tests pass

tasks.title: Import n8n workflows
deliverables: All 5 workflow JSON files in workflows/ directory
WF-001 through WF-005 imported and active in n8n UI
acceptance_criteria: Manual trigger of WF-001 with dry_run=true completes successfully
n8n execution history shows successful run

tasks.title: Run live broker discovery
acceptance_criteria: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registry.brokers returns >= 50 after live run
Dashboard Broker Registry page shows brokers with categories

phases.title: Playwright Executor Service
phases.description: Build the headless browser microservice that performs all scanning and form submission.

tasks.title: Browser pool and context management
deliverables: pool.py — BrowserPool class, N contexts, context config with anti-detection
Startup sequence launches Chromium and warms pool
acceptance_criteria: GET /health returns {status: healthy, pool_available: N}
N concurrent scan requests are served, N+1 returns 503

tasks.title: Token resolver and action handlers
acceptance_criteria: CP-test: all 16 token substitution unit tests pass
Each action handler maps to correct Playwright API call

tasks.title: PlaybookExecutor — phase/step iteration
deliverables: executor.py — full phase loop, on_failure handlers, dry_run skip, confirmation detection
acceptance_criteria: Simple playbook executes all steps and returns JobResult
dry_run=true skips submit action, all others run
Error produces auto-screenshot regardless of playbook screenshot flag

tasks.title: Async job API endpoints
acceptance_criteria: POST returns job_id immediately
Worker can poll to completion
Job TTL eviction after 1 hour

tasks.title: Write playwright unit tests
deliverables: tests/unit/playwright/ — token resolver, confirmation, error classifier, screenshot path, playbook validator
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/unit/playwright/ passes
All 16 token tests pass

phases.title: Celery Workers — Scan & Removal Pipeline
phases.description: Build the background task engine that orchestrates the full scan→exposure→removal→verification lifecycle.

tasks.title: Celery app config and Beat schedule
deliverables: Beat schedule: daily_full_scan, screenshot_purge, broker_health_check, hourly_followup_check
acceptance_criteria: celery -A workers.celery_app worker --loglevel=info starts without error
Beat schedule shows all 4 periodic tasks

tasks.title: Scan tasks — dispatch chain and scan_broker
acceptance_criteria: CP-02: test_full_scan_to_web_form_removal passes
Chord callback fires after all batch tasks complete
scan_broker creates exposure and dispatches removal on found result

tasks.title: Removal request tasks
deliverables: execute_removal_request, submit_web_form_optout, send_removal_email, generate_and_send_legal_letter, followup_removal_request, process_due_followups, process_email_classification
acceptance_criteria: CP-03: confirmed removal triggers verification schedule
CP-05: followup escalates to requires_manual after 3 attempts
CCPA letter PDF generated and attached to email

tasks.title: Maintenance and registry tasks
acceptance_criteria: Screenshot files older than SCREENSHOT_RETENTION_DAYS are deleted, rows retained
Disk usage metric visible in /api/system/health

tasks.title: Write worker integration tests
acceptance_criteria: All CP-02 through CP-05 critical path tests pass
pytest tests/integration/ -m critical passes

phases.title: Mailwatcher Service
phases.description: Build the IMAP polling and email classification service.

tasks.title: IMAP client and poll loop
deliverables: imap_client.py — connect, poll, move to Processed/Error folder
acceptance_criteria: docker compose logs mailwatcher shows poll_completed every 15 minutes
Processed email appears in IMAP Processed folder

tasks.title: Email parser and classifier
deliverables: classifier.py — keyword pre-filter + regex two-stage engine
patterns.yml with all 4 classification types and example patterns
acceptance_criteria: CP-09: all 3 classifier unit tests pass
patterns.yml hot-reloads on file change without restart

tasks.title: Request matcher and task dispatcher
deliverables: link_extractor.py — verification URL detection and auto-dispatch
dispatcher.py — DB writes + Celery dispatch per classification type
acceptance_criteria: CP-03: email confirmed removal triggers verification schedule
Verification link extracted and click_verification_link task dispatched automatically

tasks.title: Write mailwatcher unit tests
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/unit/mailwatcher/ passes
All 9 classifier tests pass including hot-reload test

phases.title: Remaining API Routers
phases.description: Complete the remaining FastAPI routers — scans, requests, reports, notifications, system.

tasks.title: Scans router + SSE endpoint
deliverables: GET /api/scans/{id}/progress (SSE) — reads from Redis pub/sub channel
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/scans returns 202 with scan_run_id
SSE stream receives scan_progress events as scan_broker tasks complete
SSE stream closes with scan_complete event

tasks.title: Requests, reports, notifications, system routers
deliverables: Cursor pagination on requests, audit_log, notifications
GET /api/system/health reads from Redis disk_usage cache
acceptance_criteria: All 38 endpoints return expected shapes
Cursor pagination works — next page returns different records
Audit log is read-only — no delete/update endpoints

tasks.title: WebSocket notification endpoint
deliverables: Redis pub/sub subscriber — fans out to connected clients
acceptance_criteria: Two browser tabs both receive notification when create_notification task fires
Connection persists through 60s idle (heartbeat working)

tasks.title: Write remaining API unit + integration tests
acceptance_criteria: pytest tests/ -v overall coverage >= 80%
All CP-06, CP-07, CP-08 critical path tests pass

tasks.title: App foundation — stores, api client, routing
deliverables: All 4 Zustand stores (auth, theme, notifications, scanProgress)
Axios client with JWT interceptor and 401/429 handlers
React Router routes with RequireAuth guard
acceptance_criteria: CP-10: JWT never stored in localStorage test passes
Unauthenticated route redirects to /login
Theme persists through page refresh

tasks.title: WebSocket hook and SSE hook
deliverables: useScanSSE.js — EventSource lifecycle tied to scanProgressStore
acceptance_criteria: Notification bell badge increments on new notification without page refresh
Scan progress bar moves in real time during active scan

tasks.title: Common components
deliverables: StatusBadge, ScoreGauge (animated SVG), ScoreTrendChart, DataTable, EmptyState, LoadingSkeleton, ErrorBanner, ConfirmDialog
acceptance_criteria: StatusBadge component tests all pass
ScoreGauge component tests (stroke-dashoffset) all pass
ScoreGauge animates on score change

tasks.title: Dashboard, Profile Detail, Request Tracker pages
deliverables: DashboardPage — stats cards, profile gauges, activity feed
ProfileDetailPage — 4 tabs with exposure trend, broker status, requests, fields
RequestTrackerPage — filter tabs, paginated table, row expansion with timeline
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard loads in < 2s
Profile score gauge animates on load
Request filter tabs update visible rows correctly

tasks.title: Reports, System Health, Settings, Onboarding pages
deliverables: ReportsPage — 4 tab report views with export buttons
SystemHealthPage — service grid + disk bars + queue depth
acceptance_criteria: CSV export triggers file download
System Health shows all services green on healthy stack
Onboarding wizard redirects to dashboard and never re-shows after completion

tasks.title: Write frontend tests
deliverables: Store tests, hook tests, component tests, page tests per DOC-13
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run passes
Frontend coverage >= 75%
CP-10 localStorage test passes

phases.title: E2E Tests & Final Verification
phases.description: Run the full test suite against the live stack and verify all critical paths.

tasks.title: Set up E2E test infrastructure
acceptance_criteria: npx playwright test --list shows all test files
docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up passes health check

tasks.title: Write and run all E2E tests
acceptance_criteria: npx playwright test passes on Chromium and Firefox
CP-11, CP-12, CP-13 all pass

tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all quality gates
commands: npx playwright test — all E2E pass
acceptance_criteria: All 13 critical paths (CP-01 through CP-13) pass
No test marked critical is failing
Coverage gates met

tasks.title: Run security verification checklist
deliverables: All 12 security checks executed and documented
acceptance_criteria: All 12 checks return expected results
No secrets visible in git history: git log -p | grep -i password — returns nothing sensitive

tasks.title: Onboard household and run first live scan
deliverables: At least 1 household profile with full PII fields
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows exposure score < 100 (exposures found)
Removal requests visible in Request Tracker
Audit log shows scan_started and removal_initiated events

tasks.title: Configure backup schedule
acceptance_criteria: crontab -l shows backup entry
Backup decrypt + tar listing completes successfully

tasks.title: Configure secret rotation reminder
acceptance_criteria: crontab -l shows quarterly reminder entry

tasks.title: Bookmark maintenance procedures
deliverables: Runbook bookmarked or printed for reference
acceptance_criteria: Operator can execute weekly maintenance check in < 10 minutes using DOC-14

completion_definition.description: HomeGuard is considered fully implemented when ALL of the following are true
criteria: All 11 phases completed with acceptance criteria met
All 13 critical paths (CP-01 through CP-13) passing
At least 1 household profile onboarded with real PII
First full scan completed and removal requests created
Daily backup schedule running and verified restorable
System Health dashboard shows all services green

effort_summary.note: Phases 4, 7, and parts of 8 can be parallelised. Solo developer realistic timeline: 6-8 weeks.
